about: The versions the web installer offers, newest first: the one source for the installer's version chooser, the landing page's 'New in X' and the packages web/make_site.py publishes under firmware/. Written by hand from docs/releases/X.Y.md for players (no internals). sha256 is the package's (choralroot-X.Y.fwsc), from the release's SHA256SUMS: make_site.py refuses a package that does not match it, and the page checks it again in the browser before any write. Adding a release: docs/HANDOFF.md, 'Release steps'. tests/releases_test.py checks this file.

minimum.note: 0.15 and older are not offered here: they have no protected update path (the boot stub that brings an interrupted update back arrived in 0.16), and 0.14 and 0.15 have a known fault: after ten minutes without playing the FM-1 stops responding until it is switched off and on.
minimum.boot_safe: 0.16 to 0.19 carry the same boot stub. An install from one of them to another that is cut off comes back in update mode: switch the FM-1 on, three flashes, press Install again. Only the first install of one of them over another firmware (the stock one, Felucca, Melodee, ChoralRoot 0.15 or older) is unprotected during its first second.

releases.title: Beta: P5, 128 sound slots, favorites
bullets: A new engine, P5: the Prophet-5 model of Melodee, with 115 of Sequential's factory programs and up to eight voices with Dual Core on.
128 sound slots shared by all engines (until now 32): your 32 sounds are copied over at the first start. P5 sounds can be saved too.
Favorites: mark any sound in the SAVE menu, give it a type (Both, Chord or Bass) and turn the filter on to step through your favorites only.
FM TONE in the Digitone's ranges and times (measured on a Digitone), with two decimals where the Digitone has them and all 57 LFO destinations; Digitone .dnsnd sounds import in the device manager.
The knobs accelerate: slow for fine steps, quick for big ones. Hold OPT to snap to round values.
The VA's filter envelope depth has two decimals, and a synced LFO has 42 rates, from 8 bars to 1/256 and a few milliseconds.
Chord numerals in Key Mode (KEY layer, page 2), and a cursor for naming a sound.
Dual Core is on for a new FM-1 and after Reset Settings, and turns itself off after a crash; a Single core package is offered under Advanced for FM-1s that have trouble with it.
notes: A beta: it may have bugs, and the next stable release, 0.22, replaces it. Please report problems on GitHub.

Updating from 0.21 keeps your settings, sounds and loops. FM TONE sounds from before are converted to the new ranges (close, not always exact) and keep their time numbers, which now mean the Digitone's times: mostly longer.
Going back to 0.21 later finds its 32 sounds as they were when you updated; the sounds saved on the beta, P5 and the favorites are not there (they wait for your return). The full notes have the rest.

releases.title: A smoother, wider chorus
bullets: Fixed: the chorus no longer pops or crackles while you turn Depth. It slides to the new setting instead.
Chorus Width, on KNOB 3 of the Chorus page: from one chorus in the middle (0) to the full stereo spread (127, where it starts).
Width turns as smoothly as Depth and is kept with the other effect settings when you hold SAVE.
With the knobs left alone the chorus sounds exactly as it did in 0.20.
notes: Updating from 0.20 keeps your settings, sounds and loops.
Nothing sounds different until you turn the new Width knob.

releases.title: Chord names and 13ths
bullets: Options > Chord Names: keep the Orchid's names (the default) or switch to Standard lead-sheet names, such as A9, Aadd9 and A13.
Options > 6th with 7th: play the 6th an octave higher when the chord has a seventh, a real 13th. Off by default.
With Standard names, JAZZ and WTF give way to real chord names wherever one exists.
Fixed: long chord names are no longer cut short on the Chord, Keyboard and Geek Out views.
notes: Updating from 0.19 keeps your settings, sounds and loops.
Nothing sounds or reads different until you change one of the two new options.

going_back.short: Your saved sounds, loops and settings stay. You lose the chorus's Width knob.
points: 0.20's chorus is always the full spread, and its Depth clicks again while you turn it.
0.20 ignores the Width that 0.21 stored; nothing else is lost or reset.
If you hold SAVE while on 0.20, the stored Width is dropped: 0.21 starts at 127 again when you come back.

releases.title: The sound release
bullets: A cleaner output: full chords with the bass no longer sound rough at full MASTER. Options > Output switches between Clean (new) and Classic (as before), so you can compare.
The chorus is stereo: on headphones it spreads out instead of sitting in the middle.
CZ-1 no longer pops when a chord is struck again or changed, its bass no longer clicks, and it now sits level with the other engines (6 dB quieter).
USB recording at 48 kHz as an option (Options > USB Rate), for phones, tablets and apps that want it.
The keys keep playing while the Options are open.
Hold GLO and turn PRESETS or ALGORITHM to change the chord or the bass engine, in the layers too.
Fixed: MASTER is right from the first note after switching on, and a speaker setting left behind by Felucca no longer thins the sound.
notes: Updating from 0.18 keeps your settings, sounds and loops.
Three things sound different by themselves: CZ-1 is 6 dB quieter, single notes are a little quieter and full chords cleaner (Output starts on Clean), and the chorus is stereo.

going_back.short: Your saved sounds, loops and settings stay. You lose the Chord Names and 6th with 7th options.
points: 0.19 names every chord the Orchid's way and plays the 6th in place.
If 6th with 7th was set to Octave up, 0.19 does not know the setting and puts Output, USB Rate and Chord Names back to their defaults; set them again there. With In place set, nothing happens.
Long secret-chord names are cut short on the views again.

releases.title: Effects, the loop editor, saving by hand
bullets: A new reverb and a new stereo delay that belong to the instrument, not to each sound.
Five engines instead of eleven: FM6, FM TONE, VA, CZ-1 and WHEEL. CZ-1 needs a third of the processor time it did, so eight-note chords hold with the bass and the effects running.
Saving is by hand: hold SAVE and the FM-1 comes back as you saved it. GLO + SAVE takes you back to the last save.
A loop editor (SEQ) that works while the loop plays, with step entry, ratchets, conditions, chance and a voicing per step.
Loop Rate: play a loop slower or faster than it was recorded.
With Single on Split Bass, a loop keeps your bass line on the bass sound.
Keys respond at once, whatever the screen is drawing.
Update mode without switching off: hold OCT-, OCT+ and HOME for five seconds.
notes: Updating from 0.17 keeps your sounds, loops and settings, with two exceptions: the reverb and the delay start at their new defaults, and a sound saved on a retired engine plays as a stand-in.

going_back.short: Your saved sounds, loops and settings stay. You lose the Clean output, the stereo chorus and 48 kHz USB recording, and CZ-1 is 6 dB louder again.
points: 0.18 reads 0.19's settings as its own. It does not know Options > Output or USB Rate: if one of them was off its default, 0.18 takes its default for one retired setting and nothing else changes.
The chorus is mono again, CZ-1 is back at its old, louder level, and USB recording is 44.1 kHz only.
In the Options the white keys jump to settings again instead of playing.
The fix for a speaker setting left behind by Felucca is not in 0.18.

releases.title: The playing release
bullets: The dancing arp is back on the Chord view, and the PERF layer shows it too.
The keys light the notes that sound, in every octave, and Key Mode lights its scale on the keys.
Key Mode can guard single notes against wrong ones (Key plays: Notes), and Keyboard: Full turns all 27 keys into an ordinary keyboard.
Split Bass: the bass sound on the left keys, the chord sound on the right.
A LOCK layer (hold B3) with two settings for how LOCK latches.
One rule in every layer: OCT- is back, OCT+ is confirm, and holding a layer's button again closes it.
Options > Reset Settings puts every setting back; your sounds and loops are not touched.
Fixed: Options > Version showed 0.1, and PANIC with LATCH on left the next chord latched.
notes: Updating from 0.16 keeps your settings, sounds and loops.

going_back.short: Your saved sounds and loops stay, but 0.17 has the old effects and the eleven engines, ignores what SAVE stored, and plays newer loops without their step settings.
points: Everything said for 0.18, and:

0.17 reads the settings as its own but starts as it always did (bass off, voicing 0) and ignores what the global save (SAVE held) stored. If you return to a newer version after 0.17 has stored a setting, that version starts from 0.17's settings.
Its own reverb and echo are back with their defaults, and each sound brings its own effect sends again.
The six engines retired in 0.18 (PHASE, LOFI, VOICE, TRIO, NOISE, PHYS) are back: sounds saved on them play on their own engines again, as long as you did not save over them.

Loops load. Ratchet, Condition, Chance and the voicing per step are not played, and the bass-side notes of a Split Bass loop play on the chord sound. If 0.17 saves such a loop again, its bass side is lost.
There is no OCT- + OCT+ + HOME gesture. Update mode is OCT- alone, held while switching on.

releases.title: The safe-update release
bullets: Fixed: the FM-1 no longer stops responding after ten minutes without playing (a fault of 0.14 and 0.15).
An interrupted update no longer leaves a dark FM-1: switch it on again, three flashes, press Install again.
Update mode on purpose: hold OCT- alone while switching on.
One core by default, as the stock firmware. Options > Dual Core On gives the bass its own eight voices.
With Dual Core on, the second core is more robust: a fault there no longer resets the FM-1.
The sound read-out counts the presets correctly.
The device manager can audition sounds on the FM-1.
notes: The first version with the boot stub: the oldest one this page installs.
Updating from 0.14 or 0.15 sets Options > Dual Core to Off.

going_back.short: Your saved sounds and loops stay, but 0.16 misreads a few newer key and LOCK settings until you set them again, on top of everything 0.17 lacks.
points: Everything said for 0.17 and 0.18, and:

With the KEY layer's keys left on play, or a LOCK setting off its default, 0.16 reads the looper's record mode as Overwrite and the PLAY menu's Keys as Play. With Key plays on Notes or Keyboard on Full it reads Key Mode as off. With Single on Split Bass it reads Full. Set them again and they are right.
No dancing arp, no scale lights, no LOCK layer, no Options > Reset Settings.
Two faults fixed in 0.17 are back: Options > Version shows 0.1, and PANIC with LATCH on leaves the next chord latched.
